name: Yumasaki Walker
original_name: 遊馬崎 ウォーカー
source: Walker, like his female friend and companion, Erika, is a very passionate otaku and manga reader, although he doesn't share the same love for yaoi that Erika does. He and Erika are nearly always together. He is a member of the anonymous online gang Dollars and is also a member of Kadota's gang.
